Landing Page.onScreen: The cinematic SENTINEL landing page — hero headline, real seeded stats, scroll-narrative sections.
Landing Page.say: This is SENTINEL — a command platform built for Gujarat Police to turn an ordinary camera network into an active investigation tool. Everything you're about to see is the real, running product, not a mockup.
keyPoints: Brand/first impression
Real seeded stats shown on the hero, not placeholder numbers
Sets up the story the rest of the video proves

Login.onScreen: Signing in as an operator into the command center.
Login.say: Access is role-based — operators, officers, and admins each see a different set of controls. We're signing in now as an administrator.
keyPoints: JWT-based auth
RBAC: OPERATOR / OFFICER / ADMIN

Command Center.onScreen: The primary landing dashboard after login — KPI tiles, live map, active alerts, camera health.
Command Center.say: This is where a shift starts. One screen tells you how many cameras are online, whether anything's degraded, how many alerts need attention, and shows every camera live on the map. Nothing here is static — it's polling the real system continuously.
keyPoints: Single-glance operational awareness
Live polling, not a snapshot
Every number traces back to a real table

Live Monitoring Wall.onScreen: A multi-camera video wall, switching grid density.
Live Monitoring Wall.say: This is the live monitoring wall. Every tile shows its actual playback state honestly — live, recorded, or offline — so an operator never mistakes a stale frame for a live feed. You can scale the wall from one camera up to a full grid.
keyPoints: Honest LIVE/DEGRADED/RECORDED/OFFLINE badges — never fakes a live feed
Scales grid density

Camera Network.onScreen: The camera grid showing status, location, and detection activity per camera.
Camera Network.say: Here's the camera network at a glance — where each camera is, whether it's online, and what it's seeing right now.
keyPoints: Per-camera status + location + recent activity

Camera Detail Modal.onScreen: A camera detail popup: latest detection frame, metadata, health history.
Camera Detail Modal.say: Clicking into a camera gives you its full picture — the latest frame it captured, its coordinates, frame rate, and a history of every time it's gone offline or come back.
keyPoints: Per-camera metadata + health transition history

Camera Management.say: This is the administrative side — the full camera registry, where a camera actually gets onboarded, edited, or retired from the network.
keyPoints: Admin CRUD over the camera catalogue

Camera Reliability Intelligence.onScreen: A reliability + video-quality scoring table across all cameras.
Camera Reliability Intelligence.say: Sentinel doesn't just ask 'is the camera online' — it tracks reliability over time, and separately, whether the footage that camera produces is actually usable for plate reading. A camera can be online and still be giving you unusable video, and this is where that shows up before it becomes a blind spot.
keyPoints: Reliability score vs. video-quality score are two separate, honest axes
Explicitly not a failure predictor — a stability statistic

Global Search (Command Palette).onScreen: Pressing Ctrl+K and typing a plate number to jump straight to it.
Global Search (Command Palette).say: From anywhere in the platform, an operator can hit a keyboard shortcut and search a plate, a camera, an incident, or a case number directly — no need to know which page it lives on.
keyPoints: Universal keyboard-driven search across every entity type

Advanced Investigation Search.onScreen: The structured filter search, followed by a plain-English AI search query.
Advanced Investigation Search.say: For deeper investigations, there's a full filter console — plate, camera, time window, confidence, whether it has an alert. And for a faster ask, you can just type it in plain English, and Sentinel parses it into the same real filters underneath — no external AI call, no guessing.
keyPoints: Structured filters
Plain-English query parsed deterministically into the same filters

Alert Log.onScreen: The alert log — watchlist hits and AI-flagged anomalies, with action buttons.
Alert Log.say: Every watchlist match and every AI-flagged anomaly lands here. An operator can acknowledge it, pull up the evidence, escalate it, or turn it directly into a tracked incident.
keyPoints: Alert → acknowledge / escalate / promote to incident workflow

Watchlist Management.say: This is the list every single detection gets checked against in real time — wanted and stolen vehicles, with priority and an effective time window.
keyPoints: The matching source-of-truth for real-time alerting

Vehicle Investigation Workspace.onScreen: Searching a plate and landing in the unified workspace — sightings, evidence carousel, map, and timeline together.
Vehicle Investigation Workspace.say: This is the heart of an investigation. Search one plate, and Sentinel brings together every camera that has seen it, the evidence frame from each sighting, and a timeline — all synced together in one screen. This is what separates a camera network from an investigation platform: one camera saw a car; Sentinel shows you everywhere it's been.
keyPoints: Unified evidence + map + timeline, synced
The platform's core differentiator

GIS Investigation Console.onScreen: The same plate traced as a route on the Gujarat map.
GIS Investigation Console.say: The same journey, laid out geographically — the exact route the vehicle took across the city's cameras, in order.
keyPoints: Chronological route on a real map

Investigation Graph.onScreen: A node graph connecting the vehicle to its cameras, alerts, incident, case, and evidence.
Investigation Graph.say: And here's the same investigation as a connected graph — the vehicle, every alert it triggered, the cameras that saw it, and the case it's now part of, all linked. This is built deterministically from what's actually stored — nothing here is inferred or guessed by a model.
keyPoints: Deterministic graph, not an LLM guess
Every node links to its real record

Traffic Intelligence.onScreen: Live traffic volume, vehicle-type breakdown, and a density heatmap.
Traffic Intelligence.say: Beyond individual vehicles, Sentinel aggregates traffic patterns across the whole network — volume, peak hours, congestion, and where traffic is concentrated on the map. This runs off the same detection data, no separate video processing.
keyPoints: Live SQL aggregation, not a second video pipeline

AI Anomaly Detection.onScreen: A list of AI-flagged wrong-way driving, restricted-zone entry, and stopped vehicles.
AI Anomaly Detection.say: Sentinel also watches for behavior that a plate lookup alone won't catch — a vehicle going the wrong way, entering a restricted zone, or sitting still somewhere it shouldn't. Each one comes with the reasoning behind the flag, not just a black-box score.
keyPoints: Explainable anomaly detection with stated reasoning

ANPR Intelligence.onScreen: Plate-recognition success rate, failure-reason breakdown, and per-camera quality.
ANPR Intelligence.say: This is where we're honest about plate-reading performance — the read success rate, exactly why a plate failed to read when it does, and which cameras are performing best and worst.
keyPoints: Transparent about failure modes, not just a headline accuracy number

AI Copilot.onScreen: Asking the Copilot a plain-English question and getting a full journey answer.
AI Copilot.say: Instead of clicking through pages, an investigator can just ask. This runs fully deterministically off recorded Sentinel data — it never invents a fact — and it works completely offline if needed.
keyPoints: Deterministic-first, offline-capable
Never fabricates — answers only from persisted records

Incident Detail.onScreen: A full incident record — evidence attached, AI summary generated, status workflow.
Incident Detail.say: Once an alert becomes real police work, it's tracked here as an incident — evidence attached, a generated summary of what happened, and a full audit trail of status changes and assignment.
keyPoints: Alert → tracked, assignable incident with evidence + audit trail

Case Detail.onScreen: A case grouping the incident, multiple pieces of evidence, and a report export.
Case Detail.say: A case groups one or more incidents and all their evidence around a single line of enquiry, and it exports directly into a report an officer can file.
keyPoints: Incident(s) + evidence -> exportable case report

Reports Center.onScreen: One-click CSV/PDF report generation across every operational category.
Reports Center.say: Every one of these workflows also rolls up into a report — vehicle detections, watchlist matches, camera health, a full vehicle journey — generated on demand.
keyPoints: Operational reporting across the whole platform

My Work Queue.onScreen: A personal queue of urgent, overdue, and assigned work.
My Work Queue.say: For an individual officer, this is the single list of what actually needs their attention right now, pulled from alerts, incidents, and cases together.
keyPoints: Cross-entity personal work queue

Operations Dashboard.onScreen: The denser legacy single-page operations view.
Operations Dashboard.say: For operators who want everything on one dense screen rather than navigating between pages, this view keeps the camera grid, alerts, and stats together.
keyPoints: Alternative dense single-page layout

GIS Camera Map.onScreen: A full-screen clustered map of the camera network.
GIS Camera Map.say: And the full camera network, geographically, with clustering so it scales cleanly as more cameras come online.
keyPoints: Standalone full-network map, clustering for scale

System / Observability.onScreen: Backend/AI pipeline health, capacity model, and the notification center.
System / Observability.say: Under the hood, this is where the system watches itself — pipeline throughput, processing latency, and how current load compares to what the architecture is designed to scale toward.
keyPoints: Self-observability
Capacity model clearly separated from current measured load

Admin Audit Log.onScreen: An append-only log of every privileged action taken in the system.
Admin Audit Log.say: And for accountability, every sensitive action — a login, an evidence access, a watchlist change — is recorded here, permanently.
keyPoints: Append-only audit trail for accountability

Final System Overview.onScreen: Back to the Command Center, holding on the complete, live platform.
Final System Overview.say: From a single camera to a fully connected investigation — detection, correlation, evidence, and case, all in one platform. This is Sentinel.
keyPoints: Closing beat — ties the whole walkthrough back to one coherent system
